page: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v6 is an Edsv6-family virtual machine configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

The server includes 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. The integration of high-capacity local solid-state storage alongside dedicated compute resources makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring rapid temporary data access. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the E128ds_v6 offers high resource density by combining a large memory footprint with substantial local NVMe storage on a single virtual machine. This configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, enterprise applications, and data-processing tasks that benefit from a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed local storage.
